key_impacts: 3,520 houses washed away in Dakshin Bedkashi
1,800 houses partially damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi
Coastal embankment breached in six places and 20.55 km damaged
Prolonged twice-daily tidal inundation until polder rehabilitation in 2013 delayed recovery
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with a 2–6 m storm surge.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, cyclone Aila killed 33 people, washed away 3520 houses, and partially damaged 1800 houses.
The storm surge overtopped the coastal embankment, breached it in six places and damaged 20.55 km.
